styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium tech smartphone ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep charcoal #1C1C1E for hero panels, clean white #FFFFFF, blush pink #F4E3E0 for info and variant panels, charcoal text #3A3A3C and one tech-blue accent #2E7CE4; neutral soft diffused studio lighting with controlled rim highlights along metal frames and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif type with #FFFFFF headlines on dark panels and charcoal text on light panels; consistent rounded rectangular info labels; consistent thin-line icon style in accent blue #2E7CE4; clean high-end electronics photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; slim smartphone always rendered with straight undistorted edges and a neutral abstract gradient wallpaper on screen with no real UI; stable product scale and placement, every frame composed as one complete balanced layout; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no warped straight lines, no fake brand UI on screens.
